overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair did not anticipate the habitat-clearing topic 48 hours before the meeting, minutes timing could not be shown late, and filing with the Town Clerk is not required. The 14-day response claim was not reviewed.

allegations.summary: Committee allegedly discussed and acted on a habitat-clearing item at its Feb. 16, 2012 meeting without listing it on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: thus the Committee did not violate the law by discussing removing invasive ground cover next to the ninth hole.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to make the Feb. 16, 2012 minutes available within ten days of his verbal request.
allegations.key_passage: Because it is not clear when the request for the February 16, 2012 minutes was made, we decline to find that they were not made available to Mr. Geiger within ten days of his request.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to submit its meeting minutes to the Town Clerk.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we do not find that the Committee violated the law by failing to submit meeting minutes to the Town Clerk.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Committee failed to respond to his complaint within 14 business days, a claim not raised in the original complaint to the Committee.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review this allegation, as it was not raised in the initial complaint filed with the Committee.
